description: This source file implements the LoopNest class and related analysis, transformation, and utility functions for managing nested loops and tensor computations within the PyTorch JIT tensor expression (tensorexpr) subsystem. It defines loop splitting, vectorization, loop fusion, reordering, and condition optimization routines, as well as classes for IR mutation, analysis, and manipulation relevant to tensor loop nests.

classes.name: IndexFlattener
classes.description: IRMutator subclass that flattens multi-dimensional index loads and stores into single-dimensional ones by replacing index expressions with flattened equivalents.

classes.name: VarNameSanitizer
classes.description: IRMutator subclass that sanitizes variable and buffer names to valid C++ identifiers, ensuring no name conflicts, and handling variable renaming through levels.

classes.name: Vectorizer
classes.description: IRMutator subclass that attempts to vectorize loop bodies and expressions where possible, supporting various operators and constructs, setting a success flag.

classes.name: IfThenElseReplacer
classes.description: IRCloner subclass that replaces a specific IfThenElse node with a new expression during pattern-based conditional optimization.

classes.name: LoadOrStoreUseFinder
classes.description: IRVisitor subclass that finds load and store usages of buffers in statements, returning a mapping of buffers to their load/store uses.

classes.name: ContainedStmtsFinder
classes.description: IRVisitor subclass that finds all contained Store, ExternalCall, ExternalCallWithAlloc, and Block statements within a given statement.

classes.name: StmtDeleter
classes.description: IRMutator subclass that deletes specific statements (e.g., dead stores) from a statement block.

classes.name: FunctionInliner
classes.description: IRMutator subclass that attempts to inline a store's value into other statements, replacing buffer accesses with inline expressions, and managing special cases like random intrinsics.

methods.name: LoopNest::initialize
methods.description: Initializes the LoopNest object with given output tensors and tensors to compute, setting up the root statement as a block of loops.

methods.name: LoopNest::vectorize
methods.description: Attempts to vectorize a for-loop, converting it into a vectorized form if conditions are met.

methods.name: LoopNest::splitHead
methods.description: Splits a for-loop at a given factor, producing a head and tail loop for loop tiling.

methods.name: LoopNest::splitTail
methods.description: Slices a loop at a tail factor, creating a tail loop.

methods.name: LoopNest::distributeLoop
methods.description: Distributes a loop over inner loops based on a set of pivot statements, creating separate loop chunks.

methods.name: LoopNest::fuseLoops
methods.description: Attempts to fuse multiple loops into a single loop if they are compatible, e.g., same bounds and no dependencies.

methods.name: LoopNest::reorder
methods.description: Reorders a sequence of loops according to a permutation tube, respecting loop dependencies and structure.

methods.name: LoopNest::optimizeConditionals
methods.description: Analyzes and simplifies conditional constructs within loops, potentially splitting loops and replacing conditionals for optimization.

methods.name: LoopNest::vectorizeInnerLoops
methods.description: Finds innermost loops in the nest and attempts to vectorize them.

methods.name: LoopNest::sliceHead
methods.description: Slices a loop at the head by a given factor, adjusting bounds and inserting new segmented loops.

methods.name: LoopNest::sliceTail
methods.description: Slices a loop at the tail by a specified factor, creating new tail loops with adjusted bounds.

methods.name: LoopNest::splitWithTail
methods.description: Splits a loop into inner and tail loops at a given factor.

methods.name: LoopNest::splitWithMask
methods.description: Splits a loop into inner and mask-based tail loops.

methods.name: LoopNest::distributeLoopOverInnerLoops
methods.description: Distributes a loop over its inner loops, creating multiple loop nests.

methods.name: LoopNest::hasLoopCarriedDependence
methods.description: Checks if a loop has loop-carried dependencies that prevent fusion or reordering.

methods.name: LoopNest::unsafeFuseLoops
methods.description: Privately fuses loops without checking dependencies, used internally for loop combination.

methods.name: LoopNest::getLoopAt
methods.description: Retrieves a nested loop at specified indices within a root loop structure.

methods.name: LoopNest::tile
methods.description: Performs tiling on a pair of nested loops with specific factors.

methods.name: LoopNest::areLoopsPerfectlyNested
methods.description: Checks whether a given sequence of loops are perfectly nested.

methods.name: LoopNest::fullUnroll
methods.description: Unrolls a loop completely by replicating its body for each iteration.

methods.name: LoopNest::unroll
methods.description: Unrolls a loop by a specified factor, creating nested loops for the tail part.

methods.name: LoopNest::isNormalized
methods.description: Checks if a loop has been normalized (start at zero).

methods.name: LoopNest::normalize
methods.description: Normalizes a loop so that its start is zero and stop is adjusted accordingly.

methods.name: LoopNest::getLoopStmtsInLoopNest
methods.description: Retrieves a sequence of nested loops starting from a specific loop.

methods.name: LoopNest::flatten
methods.description: Flattens a perfectly nested set of loops into a single loop.

methods.name: LoopNest::compressBuffer
methods.description: Optimizes buffer dimensions by removing loop-dependent dimensions that are only accessed in a loop-invariant manner.

methods.name: LoopNest::compressAllBuffers
methods.description: Applies buffer compression to all buffers within a statement.

methods.name: LoopNest::getLoopStmtsFor
methods.description: Gets the sequence of nested For loops corresponding to a specific tensor or buffer.

methods.name: LoopNest::getLoopBodyFor
methods.description: Finds the loop body that encloses a given tensor or buffer.

methods.name: LoopNest::getParentLoop
methods.description: Recursively finds the parent loop of a given statement.

methods.name: LoopNest::getEnclosingLoopNest
methods.description: Returns all the loops enclosing a specific statement.

methods.name: LoopNest::getAllWritesToBuf
methods.description: Finds all statements that write to a specific buffer.

methods.name: LoopNest::getAllInnermostLoopsWritingToBuf
methods.description: Finds all innermost loops that write to a specific buffer.

methods.name: LoopNest::getAllLoopNestsWritingToBuf
methods.description: Finds all nested loops that write to a specific buffer.

methods.name: LoopNest::simplify
methods.description: Simplifies the root statement by applying IR simplifications.

methods.name: StmtPtr FlattenIndexes(const StmtPtr & s)
methods.description: Function that applies index flattening to a complete statement.

methods.name: LoopNest::computeAt
methods.description: Transforms loops to compute a tensor at a specific nested loop, effectively moving computation closer to usage with potential buffer reuse.

methods.name: LoopNest::rfactor
methods.description: Performs R-operator factorization on a reduction statement, splitting the reduction for potential parallelization or optimization.
